title: NP-completeness of SAT, 3-SAT and their variants (the Cook–Levin theorem) in Lean 4
summary: A Lean 4 proof of the Cook–Levin theorem and of the NP-completeness of several variants of satisfiability, for an explicit machine model, using only Lean's core library. The compared theorems state that the following languages are NP-complete: SAT, the set of binary codes of satisfiable CNF formulas (Complexity.sat_np_complete); 3-SAT, with at most three literals per clause (threeSAT_np_complete); exactly-3-SAT, with exactly three literals per clause on three distinct variables (exactThreeSAT_np_complete); (≤1,≤2)-SAT, with two or three literals per clause and every variable occurring at…
